units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:2:3">Y. Sabb. V, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>לבובין</he>) <he>נותן … והוא מַתְרִיס כנגד חיה</he> one places a hide from the tannery against its heart, and this protects it against attacks of wild beasts.

<cite ref="Yevamot 121b:14">Yeb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>שה׳ עם שמנים וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>שהתירם</he>, corr. acc.) who debated with eighty-five elders; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ <he>שהיו מַתְרִיסִין כנגד וכ׳</he> who debated with R. H.
